newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: MANILA TERTIARY ISSUES LEAD GAINERS IN MID-TRADE.
newsitem.headline: MANILA TERTIARY ISSUES LEAD GAINERS IN MID-TRADE.

text.p: Tertiary issues lead gainers in midsession at the Philippine stock market on Friday on local buying, brokers said.
"Most of the investors are playing around speculative issues where they can go in and out immediately," said Carl Valentin, trader at Asia Pacific Capital Equities.
The highest gainer Republic Resources and Development Co posted a nine percent rise to 2.18 pesos while the biggest loser Seafront Resources Corp registered a 6.67 percent fall to 0.70 centavos.
Republic Resources A was the most heavily traded issue with turnover at 249.75 million pesos.

Magnum International Securities research head Mayenne Katimbang said the general market was confined in a tight range with buying on speculative issues while investors took profits in blue chips like Ayala Land Inc and Metrobank.
